definitions.full: H8551. tamak [ תָּמַךְ ] verb grasp, support, attain (Aramaic תְּמַךְ Pa`el hold fast ; compare Phoenician and Old Aramaic תמכאל El hath sustained Lzb 386 SAC 121 Cooke 361 ); — Qal Perfect . 3 feminine singular תָּֽמְכָה Psa 63:9 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִתְמֹךְ Prov 29:23 , 3 masculine plural יִתְמֹ֑כוּ Job 36:17 ; Prov 5:5 , etc., Infinitive absolute תָּמֹךְ Psa 17:5 ; construct תְּמֹךְ Isa 33:15 ; Participle תּוֺמֵךְ Amos 1:5 , 8 , תּוֺמִיךְ Psa 16:5 (? read מֵיךְ +? § 51e , or תֹּמֵךְ , compare Vrss Du; > 0l תּוֺסִיף , Bi Che תָּמִיד ), etc.; — 1 grasp, lay hold of , with accusative of thing Gen 48:17 (E), Prov 31:19 (|| בְּ יד שׁלּח ); accusative of person (wisdom) 3:18 (|| מַחֲזִיק ); accusative of thing (grasp and) wield Amos 1:5 , 8 ; Psa 16:5 (see above) thou dost grasp my lot (i.e. take and cast it for me, compare modern Palestinian may Allah uphold my lot Bergheim PEF 1894, 194 ); figurative, Job 36:17 judgment and justice seize (thee; but see obscure and doubtful); Prov 5:5 her steps lay hold of Sh®°ôl (keep the path to it); literal, with ב of thing Isa 33:15 , ב person Prov 28:17 (or below 3 ; meaning dubious); lay hold of, attain , honour, wealth (accusative) Prov 11:16 (twice in verse). 2 hold up, support , with בְּיָדָיו Exod 17:2 (E); figurative, ב person Isa 42:1 ; Psa 41:13 ; 63:9 ; accusative of person Isa 41:10 ( ב instrumental), Prov 29:23 (opposed to הִשְׁמִּיל ), 3 hold, keep , with accusative of thing Prov 4:4 let thy heart keep my words (|| שָׁמַר ); hold firmly Psa 17:5 ( ב location; opposed to נָמֹ֫טוּ ). Niph`al Imperfect יִתָּמֵ֑ךְ חַטָּאתוֺ וּבְחַבְלֵי Prov 5:22 in the cords of his sin is he seized (|| לָכַד ).
